paragraphs.text:
“Now you know,” Charlie Foxtail murmurs. “You see my burning 
feet. Act before the rest of me changes, too.”

With a dry throat, you ask her how. She seems to fight down 
the rage.
“I cannot tell! The demon is too strong. He hungers!”

Make a Psychology roll: if you succeed, go to 212; if you fail, go to 
127.
